description: This course examines key legal issues for professionals in IT-driven sectors. Topics include intellectual property of digital content, data privacy, IT service contracts, and e-commerce regulation. Aimed at non-lawyers, it provides essential background to help IT professionals manage legal resources and understand commercial opportunities and challenges. Real-world cases illustrate legal applications in IT industries.
